The total time of the walk is t_k. Then len(r) = n, and for every i with 0 <= i < n: if a valid walk from 0 to i exists, r[i] is the minimum total time over all valid walks from 0 to i; if no valid walk from 0 to i exists, r[i] = -1.

The graph is undirected, multiple edges are allowed, and self-loops are allowed.
